prompt: At a city intersection at dusk, a red sedan runs the red light at about 50 km/h and T-bones a white delivery van that is crossing on green. The van's side caves in, the van is shoved sideways and spins partly around, and the sedan's crumpled front leaks oil onto the road. A pedestrian waiting on the corner steps back in shock. Filmed by a CCTV camera on a pole overlooking the intersection and by the sedan's dashcam.

objects.name: pedestrian
objects.span: A pedestrian waiting on the corner

objects.name: pole
objects.span: a CCTV camera on a pole

cameras.name: cctv
cameras.span: a CCTV camera on a pole overlooking the intersection

requirements.text: the sedan runs the red light

requirements.formula: F (hits(sedan, van) & left_of(sedan, van) | hits(sedan, van) & right_of(sedan, van))

requirements.text: the van is crossing on green

requirements.formula: F turned(van, 30, since=hits(sedan, van)) & G !turned(van, 300, since=hits(sedan, van))

requirements.text: after the crash both vehicles come to rest (a crash ends their driving)
the crumpled front leaks oil onto the road
requirements.formula: F leaks_from(oil, sedan.front) & seq(hits(sedan, van), emitting(oil), on_ground(oil, 0.5))

requirements.text: a pedestrian waiting on the corner
the pedestrian steps back in shock
the CCTV camera overlooks the crash
requirements.formula: F (hits(sedan, van) & visible(cctv, sedan) & visible(cctv, van))

requirements.text: the CCTV camera sees the pedestrian step back
the sedan's dashcam films the van as they collide
